_about: Upper limits for performance_stays_within_budgets (perf.rs), in milliseconds unless the name says otherwise. Set on 2026-11-05 from a release run on a 4-core Linux machine, with room for slower CI runners: history first rows 130-180, complete 1.7-1.9 s, frame p95 while loading 17-18, idle frame p95 7-10, jump to the last row 17-21, peak memory 70 MiB; sidebar frame p95 0.5, list rebuild for 10,000 refs 5. Raise a limit only with the measurement that justifies it.
